tags.name: comment
tags.value: Computes the 2y-10y spread. Fires when the 2-year yield exceeds the 10-year yield (inversion). A positive bias of 0.01 means the neuron activates when the weighted sum exceeds -0.01, i.e. when the 2y yield is above the 10y yield. Yield curve inversion is one of the most reliable recession predictors in financial history.

tags.value: Append-mode redeclares output-0 with MINIMUM squash — directly seeds min(priceRecommend, volumeRecommend), mirroring the LearnUtil training label max(min(volumeRecommend, priceRecommend, 1), -1). Both inputs are already in [-1, 1] so the outer clamps from LearnUtil.ts are no-ops and not seeded here. Pattern matches DNA-CAPPED.json.

tags.name: comment
tags.value: volume-recommend (input-183) is already a recommendation in [-1, 1] derived purely from asOf-available volume data. Feeds output-0 alongside the demoted previous output; with squash=MINIMUM the seeded output is min(volumeRecommend, priceRecommend).

tags.name: comment
tags.value: Append-mode bridge: with firstDnaOutputIndex=100000 and dna.neurons.length=1, adjustIndx maps fromRelative=99999 to the originally-output-0 neuron (now demoted to hidden). This becomes the priceRecommend branch — the previous network output is the price-side estimate.
